text:
Maya: Dropped a prototype for compact invoice rows + token-denomination toggle: https://www.figma.com/file/abc. Main questions: collapse behavior for long invoices, denom label placement, and download affordances. PTAL.
Jon: Compact rows look good. For long invoice descriptions, collapse to one line with a chevron to expand. Avoid truncating invoice IDs.
Priya: Denomination toggle: default to tokens but show a tiny unit chip next to the numeric (e.g., '1.2M • tokens') so users don't lose context.
Ethan: Bulk download: prefer header action + per-row menu. Header action should only appear when at least one row is selected to avoid clutter.
Clara: Accessibility: collapsed rows must expose a visible expand button with aria-expanded and a clear focus style. Also ensure the expanded region is announced to screen readers.
A11yBot: scan: .denom-chip needs contrast improvement; collapsed chevron missing aria-label; bulk download button needs aria-disabled when no rows selected.
Maya: Good notes. I'll add aria-expanded and aria-live announcements for expand/collapse. Will update denom chip color token.
Jon: Also put invoice ID first in the row so it's scannable. Date and amount can follow.
Priya: Microcopy: change "Tokens" to "API tokens" in the denom toggle and tooltip. Tooltip: "Switch display between API tokens and USD cost."
Ethan: Interaction detail: when user switches denom, persist preference per-user and emit telemetry `billing.denom_change` with previous/new.
Clara: Keyboard flow: tab to row -> space to toggle select -> enter to open invoice details -> esc to close. Document this in the spec.
Maya: I'll update the figma frames with: 1) collapsed-one-line pattern, 2) denom chip placement, 3) header bulk action visibility, and 4) a11y checklist + telemetry keys. Posting update by tomorrow morning.
Priya: Thanks 1 1 small win for clarity.
Jon: Nice work.
A11yBot: re-scan pending color token update.
